note: pristine = SHA256 of the file exactly as published on npm 0.6.3. previous = SHA256 of an older revision of OUR OWN patch (so an upgraded payload can replace it). payload/lib holds the patched file we ship. The self-heal writes the payload back only while the installed file matches pristine or a previous payload; anything else (a real upstream release) is left untouched. The macOS revision of the patch (index.js 4d62fa96…, client.js c2718e60…: the 2026-10-17 session-anchoring build, whose only delta from the payload is the official single-line sessionsRoot()) is recorded in previous so a Mac install upgrades cleanly instead of reporting unknown-version.
